payload.body: You tend to know that a boundary has been crossed before you know how to explain it. Your body becomes tense, your answer becomes short, or you agree out loud while every part of you is refusing. This often comes from learning that anger itself was unacceptable, so the response had to appear before words were available. Turn the first physical no into one clear sentence.
payload.astroHint: Lilith conjunct Mars can make anger, action, and self-protection arrive as one immediate response.
